lessons.title: Welcome to Nur al-Ilm
lessons.learningObjective: Build immediate confidence and remove the fear of learning English.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Dropping the 'w' or saying 'Kwam' incorrectly instead of 'kom'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Round your lips for 'Wel' like blowing a kiss, then release nicely to 'kom'.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Assalamu Alaikum! Wannan dandalin na Nur al-Ilm an gina shi ne don ya koya muku tattaunawa cikin sauƙi ba tare da wahalar jarrabawa ko hadaddiyar nahawu ba. Kowa zai iya koya!
lessons.englishExplanation: Assalamu Alaikum! Introduce the friendly learning framework and remove traditional fears associated with academic language training.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Relax your throat, say 'Wel' with rounded lips, followed by a warm and simple 'come'.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Assalamu Alaikum! Barka da zuwa dandalin Nur al-Ilm! Kada ka damu, koya Turanci ba shi da wuya idan za mu yi shi daki-daki ta hanyar saurare da maimaitawa. Sannunka da zuwa!
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Wannan shi ne gatan farko! Muna jin dadin yadda kake saurare.
aiTutorScript.corrections: Maimaita bayanmu muryar da ragaɗi: 'Welcome'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Madalla! Yanzu ka fara takawa akan hanyar hasken ilimi.
aiTutorScript.motivation: Yau an bude kofa, gobe kuma za a zama zakaran tattaunawa.

lessons.listeningExercise: Saurari muryar Ustaz Nur lokacin da yake maraba da ku zuwa dakin karatu daki-daki.
lessons.speakingPractice: Say 'Welcome' clearly to register your first active learning action.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'Welcome!' Learner: 'Welcome!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A smiling, friendly teacher welcoming a student warm heartedly.

quiz.question: What is 'Welcome' in Hausa?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Mene ne ma'anar 'Welcome' da yaren Hausa?
quiz.explanation: 'Welcome' is used to warmly receive and greet people as they arrive.

lessons.assessment: Verify that the learner is listening and repeats 'Welcome' with a friendly tone.
lessons.homework: Ka fada wa bako ko kowa da ya zo gidanka yau kalmar 'Welcome'.
lessons.masteryCriteria: Pronounce the main welcoming syllables correctly.

lessons.title: You Can Learn English
lessons.learningObjective: Reinforce that anyone, regardless of background, can speak English.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Saying 'Ah kan' instead of a clear 'Ai'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Smile and pull the corners of your mouth back for 'can' so it sounds active.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Turanci ba na gwanaye kadai ba ne. Matukar kana magana da Hausa, za ka iya magana da Turanci cikin sauki. Fada wa kanka: Zan iya!
lessons.englishExplanation: Empower the learner mentally by teaching 'I can', aligning with positive self-affirmation.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Ensure 'I' is fully released as 'Ai', followed by a short crisp 'can'.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Assalamu Alaikum! Wannan babba ne: yau za mu koyi cewa ba za mu ji tsoro ba. Kalmar yau ita ce 'I can' wato za ka iya!
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Haka muke so! Muryarka cike take da kyakkyawan kwarin gwiwa.
aiTutorScript.corrections: Kar kace 'Ah kan'. Ce 'Ai... can' cikin dadi da kwarin gwiwa.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Yanzu ka fara gaskata cewa Turanci na kowa ne!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Idan wani ya ce maka Turanci yana da wahala, gaya masa: I can!

lessons.listeningExercise: Listen to a confident learner saying 'I can speak English' in a warm audio prompt.
lessons.repeatAfterMeExercise: Chime... 'I can'. Now you say it.
lessons.speakingPractice: Say 'I can' out loud to start your active speech practice.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'Can you learn?' Learner: 'I can!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A confident person standing under blue skies raising their thumbs up.

quiz.question: What is the Hausa meaning of 'I can'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Mene ne fassarar 'I can' da Hausa?
quiz.explanation: 'I can' is the direct statement of capability, meaning 'Zan iya' in Hausa.

lessons.assessment: Evaluate vocal energy and confidence during speech input.
lessons.homework: Zana babban alamun doke a dandalinka sannan ka maimaita 'I can' sau uku a murya.

lessons.title: How Learning Works
lessons.learningObjective: Explain the natural method of acquisition: Listening first, then speaking.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing the letter 't' as 'Lis-ten' with a hard 't'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: The 't' is completely silent! Pronounce it as if it is written 'Lis-in'.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Hanyar samun nasara a yaren Turanci ba farawa da kashin nahawu ba ne. Kamar yadda kuka koyi Hausa ku kuna yara, za mu fara da saurare ne tukuna kafin magana. Saurara da kyau!
lessons.englishExplanation: Address the silence of the 't' in 'Listen' and emphasize natural acoustic absorption.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Keep the 't' silent. End the word with a smooth soft nasal 'n'.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Sannu aboki! Yadda yara kanana ke koyon magana shi ne sauraro. Don haka yau za mu koyi kalmar 'Listen' dake nufin saurara.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Haka ne! Kun sanya kunnuwa wajen jin sauti lafiya.
aiTutorScript.corrections: Kada ka fadi 't' a jikin listen. Kawai fadi 'Lis-in'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Ka fadi ta daidai kamar yadda Baturiri zai fada!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Wanda zai iya saurare mai kyau shi ne zai iya magana ta gari.

lessons.listeningExercise: Listen to our nature sounds or chime sequence, and then say 'Listen'.
lessons.speakingPractice: Register your pronunciation of the instruction: 'Listen'.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'Listen!' Learner: 'Listen!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: An ear vector symbol indicating quiet attentiveness and focus.

quiz.question: Which letter is silent in the word 'Listen'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Wane harafi ne baya fita a baki (silent letter) a kalmar 'Listen'?
quiz.explanation: The letter 'T' is completely silent in 'Listen' and must not be pronounced.

lessons.assessment: Verify that the user does not pronounce the 't'.
lessons.homework: Ka yi shiru na tsawon minti guda, sa'an fadi 'Listen' lokacin da ka ji wani sauti.

lessons.title: How To Use Voice Learning
lessons.learningObjective: Instruct the user on how to interact with the voice microphone.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Saying 'Es-pik' by adding an extra 'E' or 'I' as a prefix.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Start with a direct hissing air 'Sss', then move directly to 'pik' without starting with an 'E' sound.

lessons.hausaExplanation: A Nur al-Ilm za ka yi amfani da mic don yin magana. Lokacin da ka ga alamar kore na rubutun mic, danna shi sannan ka fadi kalmar cikin sauƙi.
lessons.englishExplanation: Train the user on the action of using a microphone interface. Teach option mappings.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Form a continuous hiss 'Sss' then snap into the 'peek' high vowel ending.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Barka da hantsi! Yau za mu koyi yadda za muke amfani da muryoyinmu yayin karatu. Kalmarmu ita ce 'Speak' wato yi magana.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Masha Allah! Lafazinka yana da sanyaya zuciya.
aiTutorScript.corrections: Maimaita: 'Sss-peak'. Kar ka sanya 'E' a farko.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Yanzu ka san yadda ake kiran rubutu cikin yaren Turanci daidai!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Turanci yana baki, ba a zuciya ba. Kada ka ji tsoron kuskure.

lessons.listeningExercise: Hear a person tapping a microphone and speaking the word 'Speak'.
lessons.speakingPractice: Press the microphone button on screen and say: 'Speak'.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'Please play and...' Learner: 'Speak!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A glowing green microphone icon ready for user voice interactions.

quiz.question: What is the English word for 'Yi magana'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Wace kalmar Turanci ce ke nufin 'Yi magana'?
quiz.explanation: 'Speak' directly commands the action of talking or expressing through words.

lessons.assessment: Ensure clean 'Sp' attack transition without 'Es' vocalization.
lessons.homework: Practice saying 'Speak' clearly in front of the screen to lock in your foundation.

lessons.title: Your First English Sound
lessons.learningObjective: Successfully articulate the most basic vowel and clear mouth action.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Keeping the mouth shut too tight causing a swallowed sound.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Properly open your jaw as if the doctor is checking your throat.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Assalamu Alaikum! A wannan mataki na karshe na gidauniyar sifiri, za mu bude baki mu fitar da harafi mafi dadi 'Ah'. Gashi nan an rubuta shi, kuma abin dadi shi ne muna yawan fadin sa.
lessons.englishExplanation: Focus purely on phonetic breathing and structural jaw dropping to remove vocal stiffness.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Drop your jaw flat, maintain wide cavity and exhale a pure, clear vowel.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Sannu kwarai! Yau babu kalma mai rikitarwa, kawai za mu bude baki mu hura sauti na asali: 'Ah!'. Mu tafi tare.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Wannan shi ne daidai! Bakinka ya fita lafiya laye.
aiTutorScript.corrections: Bude bakinka sosai, kamar dakin jinya: 'Ah'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Madalla! Yanzu ka gama dukkan gidauniyar tabbaci na Sifiri!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Yanzu ka san cewa Turanci yana da sauki, kuma zaka iya koyon ko'ina.

lessons.listeningExercise: Listen to a baby happily laughing and making the wide sound: 'Ah'.
lessons.speakingPractice: Release a deep, comfortable 'Ah' sound into the receiver.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'Open your mouth and say' Learner: 'Ah'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A big bold letter A on a chalk clean board with simple phonetic indicators.

quiz.question: What is the goal of producing the sound 'Ah'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Mene ne burin fitar da sautin 'Ah' a yau?
options: Bude baki tare da rage tsoro
quiz.explanation: Opening the mouth and making the simple sound 'Ah' removes throat tightness and fear.

lessons.assessment: Sustained vowel clear tracking output.
lessons.homework: Ka duba madubi, bude bakinka, sa'an fadi 'Ah' cikin dadi da kwarin gwiwa.
lessons.masteryCriteria: Open clear resonance for 2 full seconds.

lessons.title: Greetings & Warm Words
lessons.learningObjective: Differentiate friendly greeting sounds by ear without looking at spellings.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing heavy dropping as 'Elo'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Gently push warmth out with your breath before saying 'lo'.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Assalamu Alaikum! A wannan matakin koyon sauraro, kada ku damu da yadda ake rubuta kalma. Kawai ku saurare ta a kunne sannan ku furta bayan Ustaz Nur.
lessons.englishExplanation: Focus on the acoustic nature of conversational gateways. Avoid visual text stress.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Use a soft rising tone at the end as if you are talking over a calling device.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Sannunku! A matakin yanzu muna so kunnuwanku su saba da sautin Turanci. Saurari: 'Hello'. Haruffansa na da dadi idan suka fita a baki.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Babu shakka kunnuwanku suna da kaifi!
aiTutorScript.corrections: Maimaita bayanmu: 'Hello'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Ka gane sautin gaisuwa ta farko a Turanci!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Sauraro shi ne jigo na kowane harshe.

lessons.listeningExercise: Listen to three speakers greeting with different voices: 'Hello, Hello, Hello'.
lessons.speakingPractice: Produce a warm greeting into the microphone.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'Hello my friend!' Learner: 'Hello!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A graphic depicting audio sound waves travelling towards a clean ear.

quiz.question: What is the standard verbal response when someone says 'Hello' to you?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Idan wani ya ce maka 'Hello!', wane amsa ya fi dacewa ka mayar masa?
quiz.explanation: Greeting a person who said 'Hello' with the same warm 'Hello' is standard politeness.

lessons.assessment: Accurate syllable count replication in sound test.
lessons.homework: Practice listening to children greet in English, and mock the hello sound.
lessons.masteryCriteria: Replicate standard greet pitch and voice contour.

lessons.title: Vocal Yes and No
lessons.learningObjective: Discern differences between affirmative 'Yes' and negative 'No' sounds.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Dragging the 'S' too long or soft like 'Yeh-sh'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Press tongue flat against your teeth for a crisp final 's'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Shortening to a sudden cut-off without roundness.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Keep the 'oh' sound slightly floating like a wave.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Saurari yadda ake cewa Eh (Yes) da kuma A'a (No) a sautin Turanci. Wadannan sune ababen da muke amfani dasu kowane lokaci don yanke shawara.
lessons.englishExplanation: Acoustically master yes/no confirmation sounds. Ensure soft and firm voice tones.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Produce clean dental 's' for 'Yes'. Hold the round open lips for 'No'.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Sannu aboki! Yau za mu raba tsakanin Eh da A'a. Sautin Yes da No bashi da wahala, amma yana bukatar kunne mai sauraro.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Furuci ne mai dadi da kwazo!
aiTutorScript.corrections: Domin 'Yes', ka tabbatar sautin 's' a karshe ya fita ras. 'Yes'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Yanzu zaka iya bada amsa eh ko a'a cikin manyan mutane!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Yanke shawara a kan abu shi ne mabudin tattaunawa.

lessons.listeningExercise: Hear two clear chimes, positive (Yes chime) and negative (No chime).
lessons.speakingPractice: Speak yes or no as requested by the voice.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'Are you ready?' Learner: 'Yes!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: Green checkmark for yes and high contrast red crossmark for no.

quiz.question: What is the English word for 'A'a'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Wace kalma ce da Turanci dake nufin 'A'a'?
quiz.explanation: 'No' represents immediate refusal or disagreement, matching 'A'a' in Hausa.

lessons.assessment: Verify firm responses without confusing positive/negative tones.
lessons.homework: Today practice answering home questions with simple 'Yes' and 'No' sound.
lessons.masteryCriteria: Clean distinguishing of YES and NO voice inputs.

lessons.title: Thank You & Please
lessons.learningObjective: Master gratitude and politeness sounds by ear.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing 'th' as hard 'T' or 'S' as 'Sank yu'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Put your teeth over your tongue slightly to exhale a soft 'Thhh' sound.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing dry 'Pilas' or 'Plis' with soft 's' instead of vibrating 'z'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Vibrate your throat slightly for the final 'z' in 'Please'.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Harshen Turanci yana cike da ladabi. Lokacin da ka nemi abu muna cewa Please (Don Allah), idan kuma an taimaka mana muna cewa Thank you (Na gode).
lessons.englishExplanation: Acoustic training on general politeness formulas. Address dental tongue placements.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Teeth over tongue for 'Thank'. Soft buzzing sound for 'Please'.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Assalamu Alaikum! Yau kuma darasi ne na alkhairi da ladabi. Lokacin da kake son neman taimako, fadi 'Please'. Idan an baka, ce 'Thank you'.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Madalla! Gaskiyar magana muryarka tana da albarka.
aiTutorScript.corrections: Sakar da harshenka kadan kafin 'Thank'. 'Thank... you'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Yanzu ka zama mai ladabi a yaren Turanci kowa yana son magana da kai!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Ladabi yana bude kofofin alkhairi da yawa a cikin rayuwa.

lessons.listeningExercise: Listen to a soft chime and a child receiving a gift saying 'Thank you'.
lessons.speakingPractice: Practice expressing politeness: 'Please, thank you'.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'Here is your water.' Learner: 'Thank you!'.
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: Two hands shaking gently with a heart shape above them.

quiz.question: If you want to politely ask for something, what do you say?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Idan kana son bako ko aboki ya taimake ka da wani abu cikin ladabi, me za ka ce?
quiz.explanation: 'Please' is the absolute prefix of requests to depict gentle politeness.

lessons.assessment: Verify that pronunciation incorporates the soft 'Th' and dental buzz 'z'.
lessons.homework: Tell thank you to three people who assist you with chores today.

lessons.title: Sorry & Excuse me
lessons.learningObjective: Differentiate apologizing or seeking permission politely by ear.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Vocalizing heavy 'Sor-ry' with deep gutteral 'r' or rolling like Hausa 'R'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Ensure the first syllable is light and rounded: 'Soh-ree'.

vocabulary.hausa: Gafara dai / Don Allah bani hanya
vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing 'Ekuskyus' as several pieces without the soft dental 'z' buzz.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Make the 'cuse' part rhyme with 'news' with a vibrating 'z' sound: 'Ex-kyuz... me'.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Idan ka yi kuskure ko ka taka wani ba da gangan ba, kace Sorry. Idan kana son wani ya ba ka hanya ko ka katse magana cikin ladabi, kace Excuse me. Saurari sautin sosai kamin fada.
lessons.englishExplanation: Acoustically master conversational apologies and interjections.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Soften the double 'r' in 'Sorry'. Buzz the 's' in 'Excuse' like a 'z'.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Sannunku! A wannan darasin za mu koyi yadda ake neman afuwa ko katse magana cikin girmamawa. Sautin Sorry da Excuse me yana da matukar dadi a kunne.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Masha Allah! Haka muke so, lafazi mai cike da girmamawa.
aiTutorScript.corrections: Maimaita: 'Ex-kyuz... mi'. Kar ka yi raga-raga da shi.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Ka mallaki manyan kofofin zamantakewa a kasashen duniya gaba daya!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Marar hakuri ba zai taba zama zakara a cikin kowane al'umma ba.

lessons.listeningExercise: Listen to a soft voice politely saying 'Excuse me' to pass through a crowd.
lessons.speakingPractice: Speak both words clearly into the mic.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur (knocks): 'Oh, sorry!' Learner: 'Excuse me!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A person respectfully bowing their head or making space for passway.

quiz.question: What is the English word for 'Yi hakuri'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Wace kalmar Turanci ce ke nufin 'Yi haƙuri'?
quiz.explanation: 'Sorry' is the direct and primary expression of regret or apology.

lessons.assessment: Verify clear 'z' sound ending in 'Excuse me'.
lessons.homework: Ka fada wa abokinka 'Excuse me' idan kana son wucewa ta gabansa yau.
lessons.masteryCriteria: Accurate distinction and vocalization of apologies vs. requests.

lessons.title: Food & Water Words
lessons.learningObjective: Name and articulate major essential items: Water, Rice, and Bread.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing heavy dry 'Ba-ta' or 'Waata' without fluid soft ending.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Ensure the first syllable is rounded 'Wa' and the second is a relaxed 'ter'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Rolling the 'R' like in Hausa language too heavily.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Curl your tongue behind your front teeth without letting the tip touch the roof of your mouth.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing heavy 'Biredi' with an insertion of 'i' in between.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Keep the 'B' and 'r' connected immediately without any vowel vowel: 'Breeed'.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Sannunku! A mataki na biyu na kiran sunayen abubuwa na kusa, za mu koyi kiran babban abincinmu na gida kamar ruwan sha (Water), shinkafa (Rice), da kuma burodi (Bread).
lessons.englishExplanation: Map absolute physical needs to verbal expressions with images.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Relax your lips to produce a soft flowing 'Water'. Soften the initial 'R' sound in 'Rice'. Keep 'Bread' short and crisp.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Assalamu Alaikum! Yau za mu shiga kicin na gida, mu koyi Kalmomin abinci. Fara da ruwan sha: 'Water', sa'an nan gari: 'Rice'.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Madalla! Koyo yana da dadi kwarai.
aiTutorScript.corrections: Sanyaya 'R' a jikin 'Rice' ya zama kamar ruwa dake gudu: 'Rais'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Yanzu zaka iya kiran abincin ka a kowane shago ko na baki!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Kalmori sune bishiyar da zata samar da jimloli nan gaba.

lessons.listeningExercise: Listen to the pouring of water and three children saying: 'Water, Rice, Bread'.
lessons.speakingPractice: Articulate the word for Uban abinci: 'Water'.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'What do you want?' Learner: 'Water!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A clear glass of drinking water, a bowl of steaming clean rice, and a baked loaf of bread.

quiz.question: What is the English word for 'Ruwa'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Wace kalmar Turanci ce ke nufin 'Ruwa'?
quiz.explanation: 'Water' is the universal liquid drink, matching 'Ruwa' in Hausa.

lessons.assessment: Verify clear production of 'Wa-ter' audio.
lessons.homework: Tell someone in your home: 'Give me Water' or call water 'Water' today.
lessons.masteryCriteria: Clean mapping of objects during visual cues.

lessons.title: My Family & Relatives
lessons.learningObjective: Acknowledge and vocalize central family names: Father, Mother, and Baby.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing the soft 'th' as hard 'D' or 'Pata' instead of 'Father'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Put your top teeth on your bottom lip for 'F', then slip your tongue under your teeth for 'ther'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing 'Mada' with hard D, or 'Mota' instead of 'Mother'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: The middle sound is identical to 'Father'. Pronounce with dental breath 'thuh'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing heavy 'Bibi' with flat English vowels.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Ensure the first syllable has an active slide sound: 'Bey' followed by a clean 'bee'.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Iyali sune gatan zama lafiya. A yau zamu koyi sunayen mutanen da suka fi kusa da mu: Father (Mahaifi), Mother (Mahaifiyya), da kuma Baby (Jariri).
lessons.englishExplanation: Map family structure names to clear visual portraits and phonetics.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Use soft vibrating 'th' for Mother and Father. Use a cheerful sliding vowel for 'Baby'.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Assalamu Alaikum! Yau kuma zamu yi maganar iyalanmu. Muna kaunar su ko? Fadi 'Father', sa'annan 'Mother', sannan jariri 'Baby'.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Masha Allah! Lafazinka cike yake da soyayyar iyali.
aiTutorScript.corrections: Kada kace 'Fada' ko 'Mada'. Sanya harshenka tsakanin hakora: 'Fa-ther', 'Mo-ther'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Yanzu zaka iya kiran mutanen gidanka da kyakkyawan Turanci!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Mahaifi da uwa sune asalin hasken rayuwar kowa.

lessons.listeningExercise: Listen to a happy baby laughing and parents talking in a quiet home environment.
lessons.speakingPractice: Say 'Mother and Father' clearly into the voice recorder.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'Who loves you?' Learner: 'Mother and Father!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A happy African family portrait under a cozy shelter.

quiz.question: What is the English word for 'Mahaifiya'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Wace kalmar Turanci ce ke nufin 'Mahaifiyya' ko 'Mama'?
quiz.explanation: 'Mother' means Mama or Mahaifiyya in the family language.

lessons.assessment: Verify the presence of soft 'th' instead of 'd' during father/mother voice tests.
lessons.homework: Today, show your mother your screen and call her 'Mother', do same for Father.

lessons.title: Colors of Life
lessons.learningObjective: Differentiate and name primary colors: Red, Blue, and Green.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Overly rolling the 'R' like a hard drum, or saying 'Redi'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Do not roll your tongue against the roof of your mouth. Just hold it soft and flat.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Saying 'Bulu' by splitting the starting blend with an extra 'u'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Make the 'Bl' sound together immediately, then slide directly into 'ooo': 'Blooo'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing with hard Hausa 'G' or rolling 'R' too heavily as 'Girin'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Connect 'G' and 'r' smoothly as 'Green' without adding an extra middle sound.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Duniya tana da kyawawan launuka. Yau zamu koyi launukan da muka fi gani: Red (Ja) kamar wuta, Blue (Shuɗi) kamar sama, da kuma Green (Kore) kamar ganye.
lessons.englishExplanation: Map visual colors to English names with direct oral sound replication.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Keep the 'r' sounds smooth in 'Red' and 'Green'. Ensure 'Blue' is a single syllable stream.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Barka da rana! Kalli launukan dake kewaye daku. Kalmar yau ta nuna canje-canje na launi: 'Red', 'Blue', da kuma 'Green'.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Masha Allah! Kunna dacewa da manyan idanu da lafazi mai kyau.
aiTutorScript.corrections: Hada 'Bl' a hadu a 'Blue'. Kada kace 'Bulu'. Ce 'Blu'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Yanzu zaka iya nuna launin tufafin da kake so a shago!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Launuka sune rayuwar dake bamu sha'awa kowace rana.

lessons.listeningExercise: Hear three bells of varying tones representing red, blue, and green colors.
lessons.speakingPractice: Explain the color of a green tree leaves: 'Green'.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur (pointing to sky): 'What color is the sky?' Learner: 'Blue!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: Three animated splashes of red, blue, and green paint on the screen.

quiz.question: What is the English word for the color 'Ja'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Wace kalmar Turanci ce ke nufin launin 'Ja'?
quiz.explanation: 'Red' is the universal identifier for the color Ja.

lessons.assessment: Verify that 'Blue' and 'Green' do not contain inserted flat vowels in starting consonant blends.
lessons.homework: Duba canjin haske a waje, ka fadi sunan kowane launin da ka gani da Turanci.

lessons.title: Expressing Basic Desires
lessons.learningObjective: Speak complete short needs like asking for water or food confidently.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Dropping the ending 't' in 'want' or saying 'Ina son water'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Ensure a sharp tongue snap on 't' in 'want' before sliding directly to 'water'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Saying 'Ah wan pud' by turning 'f' into a 'p'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Make a clear wind sound for 'f' like blowing out a candle: 'fffffood'.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Idan kana jin kishirwa ko yunwa, fadin 'Ina son ruwa' da Turanci shi ne: 'I want water'. Idan kuma abinci kake so, kace: 'I want food'. Zamu tsaya don koyan tattaunawar biyan bukata.
lessons.englishExplanation: Transition from dry isolated nouns to integrated complete request paths.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Ensure 'want' ends with a crisp stop consonant, followed by the fluid noun. Put teeth on lip for 'f' in 'food'.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Maraba! Yau za mu fara gina babban gini: za mu hada gajerun jimloli don biyan bukatar zuciya. Fada bayanmu: 'I want water'.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Yayi asali sosai muryarku tana fita sarai!
aiTutorScript.corrections: Sakar da sautin 'want' ya dace. Maimaita: 'I... want... water'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Masha Allah! Yanzu zaka iya nuna sha'awarka cikin dadi babu shakka!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Jimla daya zata iya ceto rayuwarka idan babu Hausawa kusa daku.

lessons.listeningExercise: A dry traveler asking for support inside a local rest stop saying: 'I want water'.
lessons.repeatAfterMeExercise: Repeat carefully: 'I want water' (chime)... 'I want food' (chime).
lessons.speakingPractice: Clearly speak the complete desire string: 'I want water'.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur (Shop): 'What do you want?' Learner: 'I want water.'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A thirsty traveler pointing to a bottle of drinking container.

quiz.question: What is the translation of 'I want water' in Hausa?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Fassarar 'I want water' da Hausa shi ne?
quiz.explanation: 'I want' means Ina so/Ina bukatar, while 'water' stands for ruwa.

lessons.assessment: Evaluate whole sequence without unnatural spacing.
lessons.homework: Ka fada wa kowa a gidanki yau 'I want water' idan kana jin khishirwa.

lessons.title: Introducing Yourself
lessons.learningObjective: Speak your name and identity clearly to new contacts.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Shortening 'name' to 'nem' with flat vowels, or pronouncing lazy 'is' as 'iss'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Slide through the 'a' sound in 'name': 'N-ey-m'.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Idan ka hadu da bako, gaisa da shi sannan ka fada masa sunanka cikin sauki ta hanyar cewa: 'My name is [Sunanka]'. Wannan zai bude kofar abota da yarda.
lessons.englishExplanation: Establish basic identity statement pattern to begin interactions.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Draw out 'My name' with a nice soft slide, ending with 'is' showing a vibrating 'z' sound.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Sannu dai! Yau kuma darasi ne na mutuntaka da gabatar da kai. Kalmarmu ita ce 'My name is'. Mu taba tare.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Barka dai kwarai! Muryarka tana nuna amana.
aiTutorScript.corrections: Sanya sautin 'is' ya zama mai karkarwa kamar 'iz': 'My name iz'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Ka koyi yadda zaka fadi babban sunanka a gaban kowa da Turanci!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Mutumin kirki yana alfahari da sunansa a kowane gari.

lessons.listeningExercise: A student stands up in a class and proudly introduces: 'My name is Amina'.
lessons.repeatAfterMeExercise: Repeat: 'My name is Amina' (chime). Now say it with your own name.
lessons.speakingPractice: Say 'My name is' followed by your real name.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'Hello! What is your name?' Learner: 'Hello! My name is...'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A clean visitor tag badge showing write-in name space.

quiz.question: What is the English phrase for 'Suna na'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Wace jimlar Turanci ce ke nufin 'Suna na'?
quiz.explanation: 'My name is' translates directly to 'Suna na shi ne' to introduce oneself.

lessons.assessment: Assess fluid connection between 'is' and learner's name.
lessons.homework: Ka fada wa bako ko yayenka a cikin gida yau: 'My name is' sannan ka fadi sunanka.
lessons.masteryCriteria: Clean slide spelling values on 'name' vowel.

lessons.title: At the Local Market
lessons.learningObjective: Interact at local markets and negotiate prices with ease.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing 'much' as 'muki' or dropping 'th' in 'this' as 'dis'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Put the tip of your tongue slightly between your teeth for 'this' to sound excellent.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Idan ka shiga kasuwar Kurmi ko Sabon Gari don sayen kaya, tambayar farashi da Turanci shi ne: 'How much is this?' Yau za mu koyi hira lokacin gudanar da ciniki.
lessons.englishExplanation: Integrate financial inquiry structures into conversational roles.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Deliver a continuous melodic flow. Ensure 'much' ends with soft air and 'this' starts with dental buzz.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Assalamu Alaikum! Yanzu lokaci ne na kasuwa. Don sayen kowane abu, lallai zaka tambayi 'How much is this?'. Mu tattauna yanzu.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Kwarewarku tana bamu sha'awa kowace rana!
aiTutorScript.corrections: Maimaita: 'How much... is this?'. Furta 'M-U-C-H' da iska mai dadi a karshe.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Madalla! Yanzu ka zama babban dan ciniki a dandalin kasuwanni!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Kasuwa tana son mai magana da basira.

lessons.listeningExercise: Audit a quick market banter in Sabon Gari where prices of goods are being discussed.
lessons.repeatAfterMeExercise: Listen to the merchant... Now ask: 'How much is this?'
lessons.speakingPractice: State the financial inquiry clearly: 'How much is this?'.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur (Seller): 'Hello customer.' Learner: 'Hello, how much is this?'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A bustling colorful African market scene with bags of grains.

quiz.question: If you want to know the price of a beautiful shirt, what do you ask?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Idan kana son sanin kudin riga a shago, me kake cewa?
quiz.explanation: 'How much is this?' is the globally acknowledged phrase to request prices.

lessons.assessment: Verify natural inflections during inquiry triggers.
lessons.homework: Ask the price of any household object from your sibling using 'How much is this?'.
lessons.masteryCriteria: Negotiation speed rating of at least competent level.

lessons.title: How Are You?
lessons.learningObjective: Inquire and respond about health and daily wellbeing.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Saying 'Hao are you' with extremely hard 'r' rolled or falling pitch.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Keep the 'are' soft and silent-r: 'Hau... ah... yoo' with a gentle rising tone.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Mumbling 'Fayin' with dropped final nasal sound 'n'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Make wide dental smile on 'fine' and touch tongue behind teeth to complete the 'n'.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Idan ka hadu da aboki, gaisawa ta gari ita ce 'How are you?' (Yaya kake?). Shi kuma zai amsa maka 'I am fine' (Ina lafiya). Zamu yi wannan gaisuwa.
lessons.englishExplanation: Master basic interactive health check-in conversational loops.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Keep a friendly melodic tone. Curve 'you' up nicely, and bite lip for 'fine'.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Sannu dai! Yau za mu koyi gaisuwa ta musamman na kyakkyawar gaba: 'How are you?' da kuma mafi dacen amsa 'I am fine'.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Masha Allah! Muryarka tana haskaka zukata.
aiTutorScript.corrections: Maimaita bayanmu: 'How ah yoo?'. Kar ka ja harafin 'r' da karfi.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Ka zama gwani gurin gaisawa da abokanka a kan titi!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Gaisuwa tana cire kiyayya, tana samar da kauna ta musamman.

lessons.listeningExercise: Hear two old friends high-fiving on a quiet afternoon and greeting happily.
lessons.speakingPractice: vocalize clear greetings into the device.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'Hello! How are you?' Learner: 'I am fine, thank you!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: Two friends drinking tea and smiling warmly under a shady tree.

quiz.question: What is the standard polite reply to 'How are you?'
quiz.hausaQuestion: Idan wani ya tambaye ka 'How are you?', mene ne amsa mafi dacewa?
quiz.explanation: 'I am fine' is the globally polite answer to signal that you are doing well.

lessons.assessment: Observe friendly rise-and-fall voice levels.
lessons.homework: Ka tambayi abokinka yau 'How are you?' ka ji ko zai fada maka lafiyarsa.
lessons.masteryCriteria: Melodic pitch movement without hard 'r' clipping.

lessons.title: Phonics Alphabet A to I
lessons.learningObjective: Complete phonetic guide mapping letters A to I directly using familiar concepts.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Keeping the jaw stiff on 'A' and pronouncing hard 'Eppel'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Open your mouth wide like you are biting a juicy round fresh apple.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Saying flat 'Bal' instead of rounded English 'Bohl'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Round your lips completely as if you are blowing a gentle tiny bubble.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing 'Sat' with an 'S' inside because of spelling visual.
vocabulary.correctionTip: The letter C here sounds exactly like the letter K. Say 'Kat' with air.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Swallowing the 'D' and saying 'Doh' short.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Let a small, soft voice bounce on your tongue tip for 'D'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing 'Igg' with high 'i' vowel.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Keep your lips open sideways, resting flat: 'Eh... g'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Saying 'Pish' by using hard 'P' instead of blowing wind.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Do not touch your lips together! Place upper teeth on lower lip to blow air: 'Ffff'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing as soft 'Jot' incorrectly.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Make a hard sound from the back of your throat: 'G-oht'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Dropping the beginning breath and saying 'At'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Exhale deep warm air from your throat as if you are laughing 'Hahaha'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Using a long, stretched 'Eee' sound instead of short flat 'Ih'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Keep the sound short and direct. Just drop your tongue flat inside.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Assalamu Alaikum! Karatu da rubutu sun dade suna zama dadi idan mu hada baki da idanu. A yau zamu koyi haruffan farko na Alphabet daga A zuwa I lafiya laye.
lessons.englishExplanation: Establish comprehensive phonic foundation from A to I with focus on letter-to-sound translation.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Emphasize correct starting dental/consonant alignment for each letter with simple visuals.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Sannu aboki! Yanzu za mu shiga duniyar karatu! Mu fara da Alphabet tun daga A, B, har zuwa I. Zan koyar da kai daki-daki.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Kwarewarka tana fita da sauri muna alfahari da kai!
aiTutorScript.corrections: Domin 'Fish', danna hakora a kan lebe. 'Fff-ish', kar kace 'Pish'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Ka mallaki babban muryoyin asali tara na harshen Turanci!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Kowane babban dutse yana farawa da kananan duwatsu na asali.

lessons.listeningExercise: Hear each letter spelled out followed by their clean phonics representations.
lessons.speakingPractice: Speak the letters and words clearly into the mic.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'What letter sits on Fish?' Learner: 'Letter F!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: Gorgeous display showing letter icons and animal icons next to each other.

quiz.question: What sound does the letter 'C' make in 'Cat'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Wane sauti ne harafin 'C' yake bayarwa a kalmar 'Cat'?
quiz.explanation: In 'Cat', the letter 'C' sounds exactly like 'K' in Hausa.

lessons.assessment: Verify that the learner differentiates dental 'F' from 'P'.
lessons.homework: Today, look at items in your house starting with A, B, C and call them out.
lessons.masteryCriteria: Clean recognition of the nine initial alphabet blocks.

lessons.title: Phonics Alphabet J to R
lessons.learningObjective: Map the starting sounds of letters J to R with visual representation and examples.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing dry 'Zog' without the 'd' boundary impact.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Push your teeth together slightly to make a strong 'Jhh' sound.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Swallowing the air at the start of 'K'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Puff out a small gasp of air from the throat: 'K-ee'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing weak flat 'Rayon' by rolling tongue as 'R'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Place your tongue tip flat against the roof of your mouth behind your front teeth: 'Llll-aion'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Dropping the ending 'k' and saying 'Mil'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Press your lips flat together as if saying something tastes delicious: 'Mmmm-ilk' with a clean ending 'k' click.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Muddling 'Nest' into 'Nes' without final 't' sound.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Touch tongue against your gums and release with a sharp clear snap 't'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Reading literally as 'Oni-on' with two heavy 'o' vowel sounds.
vocabulary.correctionTip: The spelling is tricky, but the sound starts with 'U' like 'Un-yon'. Keep it natural.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing 'Fen' by using 'F' wind sound instead of lip popping 'P'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Press your lips together, blow a tiny puff of air directly to pop: 'P-en'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Saying flat 'Kwin' without roundness.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Round your lips completely for 'Kw' followed by high stretched 'een': 'Kweeeen'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Tapping your tongue against gums causing a rolled drum 'R' sound.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Pull tongue backward in space. The tip must never hit the roof of mouth during 'Rice'.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Sannunku! A yau za mu ɗora daga inda muka tsaya. Za mu koyi haruffa tara na gaba masu daɗin tsara sauti, daga J zuwa R.
lessons.englishExplanation: Master intermediate alphabet blocks J to R, focusing on the pop sound of P and soft curl of R.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Differentiate P popping from F wind sounds, and keep the English R unrolled.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Maraba da safe! Yau kuma zamu ci gaba da ganin haruffan rubutunmu na shahararru. Kalmomin yau sune J zuwa R.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Masha Allah! Ina jin dadin rera sautin bakinka.
aiTutorScript.corrections: Domin 'Pen', hada baki ka harba iska: 'P-en'. Kada kace 'Fen'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Yanzu ka riga ka wuce rabin babban tafiyar karatu!
aiTutorScript.motivation: A hankali, za a ga cewa rubutun Turanci zai canja zuwa abokin hira.

lessons.listeningExercise: Hear speakers spelling letters J, L, M, P, R in clear, sharp audio prompts.
lessons.repeatAfterMeExercise: Say with pop energy: 'J - Jug' (chime)... 'L - Lion' (chime)... 'P - Pen' (chime)... 'R - Rice' (chime).
lessons.speakingPractice: Register pronunciation of middle alphabet sequences cleanly.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'Duba, nuna min makulli da Turanci.' Learner: 'Key! K - E - Y!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: Glinting animated letters of J to R with visual cards on display.

quiz.question: What is the correct way to start the word 'Pen'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Wace hanyar ce ta fi dacewa wajen fitar da harafi na farko a kalmar 'Pen'?
quiz.explanation: 'Pen' starts with a popping 'P' shape, not a windy 'F'.

lessons.assessment: Verify that learners do not muddle 'P' with 'F'.
lessons.homework: Today, practice saying 'POP PEN' to keep your lip muscles trained.

lessons.title: Phonics Alphabet S to Z
lessons.learningObjective: Conclude the phonic alphabet mapping from S to Z with direct descriptions.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Adding an 'E' or 'I' prefix as 'Es-san' or pronouncing too soft.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Hiss air through your front teeth like a snake without starting with a vowel: 'Sssss-an'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Saying heavy 'Ti' without dental air.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Tap the tongue behind front teeth and blow a sharp breath: 'T-ee'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing 'Yum-brela' with a leading visual Y sound.
vocabulary.correctionTip: The starting U sound is a simple open 'U' short sound like 'Uh-m'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Saying 'Fan' with blowing air (F) instead of throat rumble (V).
vocabulary.correctionTip: Touch top teeth to bottom lip, then vibrate your throat to rumble: 'Vvvvan'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Dropping the rounded lip shape completely.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Start with extremely tight lips as if whistling, then release nicely to 'Wa-ter'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Saying 'Ere' or swallowing 'ks'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Exhale with a flat 'E' and follow immediately with a sharp snake hiss: 'Eks... rey'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Dropping the 'Y' and saying 'Eloh' incorrectly.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Lift your tongue body high in the mouth to make a strong 'Y' start, then direct to 'ell-oh'.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Making clean 'S' sound like 'Sebra' without vibrating your cord.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Keep teeth closed and vibrate your throat heavily to sound like a flying fly: 'Zzzzee-bra'.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Gafara dai! Yau za mu kammala manyan Alphabet duka ashirin da shida da fatan rabuwa lafiya. Za mu ga haruffan karshe daga S zuwa Z, sannan mu duba dukkan manyan haruffa a screen.
lessons.englishExplanation: Conclude the full twenty-six alphabet blocks. Train throat rumble V/Z vs soft breath S/F.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Perform strong vibratory tests for V and Z. Teach smooth snake hiss on S.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Assalamu Alaikum! Yau kuma gagarumin rana ne, zamu kammala dukkan bango na Alphabet. Fara da S kamar 'Sun', sannan mu gaisa da Z mai layuka 'Zebra'.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Furuci ne mai dadi da kwazo, kana haskawa!
aiTutorScript.corrections: Domin 'Zebra', vibrate your throat: 'Zzzzee-bra'. Kar kace 'Sebra'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Madalla! Yanzu ka mallaki dukkan haruffa ashirin da shida a matakin farko na karatu!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Yanzu babu wani rubutu da zai baka tsoro a cikin dandalin Turanci kowane iri.

lessons.listeningExercise: Hear the full sequence from S to Z spelled out with sound cards.
lessons.repeatAfterMeExercise: Repeat carefully: 'S - Sun' (chime)... 'V - Van' (chime)... 'W - Water' (chime)... 'Z - Zebra' (chime).
lessons.speakingPractice: Release the last sequence into the interactive voice prompt.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'What letter sits at the end of the alphabet?' Learner: 'Letter Z! Zebra!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A glowing board displaying the full 26 letters from A to Z radiating colorful stars.

quiz.question: What is the key sound difference between 'Sun' (S) and 'Zebra' (Z)?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Mene ne babban banbanci tsakanin furucin harafin 'S' a 'Sun' da kuma 'Z' a 'Zebra'?
options: Z vibrates the throat, S is just blowing air
S vibrates the throat, Z is just air
One is spoken with lips rounded
quiz.explanation: Z relies on vocal cord vibration (buzzing), while S is voiceless hiss of air.

lessons.assessment: Verify throat vibration on Z sounds.
lessons.homework: Ka kalli layukan zebra ka rera sautin 'Zzzz' tsawon dakika biyar a gida yau.

lessons.title: Word Sight Reading
lessons.learningObjective: Map the spoken words we already know by sound like Water to written letters.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Reading spelling literally without phonetic mapping.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Understand that in English, letters combine to form specific sounds unlike pure literal spelling.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Kun dade kuna fadin kalmar 'Water' da baki. A yau zamu ga yadda aka rubuta ta a takarda ko screen dinku: W-A-T-E-R. Dubi yadda haruffan suka hadu don samar da sautin da kuka saba dashi.
lessons.englishExplanation: Establish sight-word connections to leverage preexisting verbal skills into reading competency.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Gaze at the letters while pronouncing the sound. Do not spell aloud during conversation.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Assalamu Alaikum! Yau kuma babban lokaci ne. Za mu fara karatu! Kun gane kalmarmu ta da: 'Water'. Dubi yadda aka rubuta ta.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Kun gani? Ba da wuya yake ba sam!
aiTutorScript.corrections: Kada ka karanta harafi-harafi yayin fada. Kawai kalli rubutun sannan ka ce: 'Water'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Ka yi nasarar karanta kalmarka ta farko a rubuce!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Duk littafin duniya yana farawa ne daga kalmar da ka riga ka sani da baki.

lessons.listeningExercise: Listen to a voice spelling 'W-A-T-E-R' and then blending details into the word 'Water'.
lessons.repeatAfterMeExercise: Look at the letters and say: 'Water'.
lessons.speakingPractice: Pronounce 'Water' as you gaze at the written word on your screen.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'How do you spell the sound we drink?' Learner: 'W-A-T-E-R... Water!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A clear, beautifully styled word card showing 'Water' with water droplets behind it.

quiz.question: Which letters are used to write 'Water'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Wadanne haruffa ne ake amfani da su wajen samar da kalmar 'Water'?
options: P - L - E - A - S - E
quiz.explanation: W-A-T-E-R is the standard written string to map the acoustic sound of water.

lessons.assessment: Verify sight recognition of 'Water' text.
lessons.homework: Ka sami kofi ko gora, sannan ka rubuta 'Water' a kai da fensiri ka kalli rubutun.

lessons.title: Copying & Typing Short Words
lessons.learningObjective: Input key characters carefully and copy simple sentences from screens.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing 'w' heavy sound at the start like 'Wirite'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Ignore the 'w' completely! It is a silent letter just like the 'T' in listen. Pronounce as 'Rait'.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Yau za mu riki alkalami ko mu danna keyboard na wayoyinmu. Za mu kwafi kalmomin da muka saba fada da baki don su zama rubutu a rubuce. Kalmarmu ita ce 'Write'.
lessons.englishExplanation: Train keyboard typing or handwriting actions. Ensure silent 'w' awareness.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Keep the starting 'w' silent. Produce a long high-i vowel sliding into 't'.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Assalamu Alaikum! Yanzu lokacin rubutu ne. Kar ku huta, yanke zance daki-daki ne zai baku nasara. Kalmarmu ita ce 'Write'.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Babu shakka rubutun muryarka yana da dadi!
aiTutorScript.corrections: Maimaita: 'Write'. Ka manta da 'W' a farko, kawai ce 'Rait'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Yanzu ka san yadda ake kiran rubutu cikin yaren Turanci daidai!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Abin da aka rubuta ya tabbata.

lessons.listeningExercise: Listen to the sound of pen scratching on clean paper, and call 'Write'.
lessons.speakingPractice: State the action word: 'Write'.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'What do you do with a pencil?' Learner: 'I write!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A stylish pencil drawing and scribbling words with animated glow.

quiz.question: Which letter is silent in the word 'Write'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Wane harafi ne baya fita a baki a farkon kalmar 'Write'?
quiz.explanation: The letter 'w' is silent at the start of 'Write' and must not be spoken as 'wi'.

lessons.assessment: Verify that the user omits 'w' during voice evaluation.
lessons.homework: Ka dauki takarda, ka kofi sentence 'I want water' tare da kula da yadda haruffan suke.

lessons.title: Sentence Construction & Typing
lessons.learningObjective: Formulate basic complete sentences from scrambled digital keyboard prompts.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Dropping the ending 't' or spelling with bad spacing.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Ensure spacing between 'I', 'want', and 'rice' is distinct on screen.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Yau zamu tafi wani babban mataki: za mu rubuta cikakkiyar jimla da kanmu! Za mu danna haruffa a jere don daidaita kowace kalma: 'I' sannan 'want' sannan 'rice'.
lessons.englishExplanation: Integrate keyboard typing layouts with dynamic phrase assembly skills.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Keep a steady rhythm while spelling. Avoid running space bars together.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Abokina! Gurgujewa ya kare, yau za mu haɗa manyan jimloli. Za mu koyi rubuta 'I want rice'. Bari mu danna tare.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Madalla! Yatsunku suna da matukar sauri da basira.
aiTutorScript.corrections: Kula da 'space' a tsakanin kalmomin. Fadi: 'I... want... rice'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Ka yi rubutun cikakken jimla a harshen Turanci lafiya!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Idan kana iya rubutawa, to babu shakka kana iya sadarwa ta kowane irin wasiƙa.

lessons.listeningExercise: Listen to typewriter keyboard clicks and clear chimes indicating correct spellings.
lessons.repeatAfterMeExercise: Say and locate on keyboard: 'I want rice' (chime).
lessons.speakingPractice: State the sentence clearly to initiate typing sequence.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur (orders): 'Please write what you want to eat.' Learner: 'I want rice!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: An elegant animated phone screen showing letters appearing in active green glow.

quiz.question: What is the correct order of words to write 'Ina son shinkafa'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Wane tsari ne ya dace wajen tsara kalmomin 'Ina son shinkafa'?
quiz.explanation: Subject-Verb-Object rule requires: I (Ina) + want (son) + rice (shinkafa).

lessons.assessment: Verify space and letter alignment of key input values.
lessons.homework: Type 'I want rice' in your app's chat and send it to Ustaz Nur today.

lessons.title: At the Hospital: Explaining Health
lessons.learningObjective: Express basic physical illnesses or request medical assistance eloquently.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing 'feel' as 'fil' with too short a vowel, or swallowing the 'k'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Stretch the 'ee' slightly as 'feeel' then release the 'k' in 'sick' cleanly.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Pronouncing 'headache' as 'head-aki' because of visual literal interpretation.
vocabulary.correctionTip: The ending letters 'ache' wave together as 'eyk' (like baking cake). Say 'Hed... eyk'.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Idan baka da lafiya, zuwa asibiti zai bukaci ka fada wa likita damuwarka. Jin rashin lafiya ana fada da Turanci: 'I feel sick'. Zamu yi kokari mu koya yadda za a gudanar da wannan tattaunawa.
lessons.englishExplanation: Acquire fundamental physical health descriptor statements to safeguard medical communication.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Extend the middle cheek smile vowel in 'feel' cleanly before executing a short crisp 'sick'. End 'headache' on 'eyk'.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Assalamu Alaikum! Idan baka jin dadi, zaka fada wa likita ko nas: 'I feel sick'. Yau zamu tattauna a kan lafiya da kariya.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Allah ya baka lafiya! Sautinka yana da kaifi sosai.
aiTutorScript.corrections: Tsawaita harafin 'feel' kadan. Kada kace 'Ai fil'. Ce 'Ai feee-l sick'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Yanzu zaka iya kare kanka ko iyalinka yayin rashin lafiya a asibiti!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Maganar asibiti tana da matukar muhimmanci a kowane lokaci.

lessons.listeningExercise: Listen to a soft medical bell and doctor responding to an urgent voice prompt.
lessons.repeatAfterMeExercise: Say with emergency care: 'I feel sick' (chime)... 'I have a headache' (chime).
lessons.speakingPractice: Speak the medical assistance statement: 'I feel sick'.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur (Doctor): 'What is the problem?' Learner: 'I feel sick. I have a headache.'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A clean hospital logo with a professional, caring doctor stethoscope.

quiz.question: What is the correct English phrase for 'Ina jin ciwon kai'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Wace kalma ce da Turanci don fadin 'Ina jin ciwon kai'?
quiz.explanation: 'headache' literally maps to 'ciwon kai', used with 'I have a' to denote presence.

lessons.assessment: Verify that vowels are well balanced to denote proper emotional and vocal tone.
lessons.homework: Practice simulating this conversation with a sibling behaving like a general doctor.

lessons.title: Money & Banking Basics
lessons.learningObjective: Complete common money transactions and direct teller requests.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Dropping the ending 'er' sound or saying 'Wia lists' incorrectly.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Ensure a round soft 'Wer' starting sound, followed by dental soft 'the' and crisp 'teller'.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Idan kaje banki don ajiye ko cire kudi, zaka hadu da ma'aikata daban-daban. Mutumin dake bayar da kudi ana kiransa 'Teller'. Tambayar inda yake shi ne: 'Where is the teller?'.
lessons.englishExplanation: Acquire spatial navigation and direct request structures inside financial institutions.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Emphasize rising question pitch 'Where...'. Connect words together smoothly.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Barka dai aboki! Kudinka yana da muhimmanci. Idan kaje banki, danna mic ka koyi neman mai bayar da kudi: 'Where is the teller?'.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Muryarka tana fitar da babban ikon kudi!
aiTutorScript.corrections: Vibrate 'Where' cleanly. Say 'Wer... iz... da... tel-luh'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Ka zama gwani wajen zirga-zirga a cikin bankunan kudi kowane gari!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Aka ce kudi na neman mai magana da basira don kariya.

lessons.listeningExercise: Audit typical crowd murmuring in bank line and cashier counting cash notes.
lessons.speakingPractice: Speak the bank inquiry sequence into the receiver.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur (Guard): 'Welcome. How can I help you?' Learner: 'Where is the teller?'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: An active safe deposit design or cash teller station representation.

quiz.question: What is the English word for 'Mai bayar da kudi' inside a bank?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Mene ne sunan ma'aikacin dake karba ko bayar da kudi a cikin banki da Turanci?
quiz.explanation: 'Teller' is the standard financial counter staff handling money.

lessons.assessment: Verify that question tone is clearly expressed through elevated end pitch.
lessons.homework: Ka tambayi yayanka inda ya ajiye kudin cefane ta amfani da 'Where is...' a yau.

lessons.title: Job Interview & Self Introduction
lessons.learningObjective: Deliver self-introductions in simple workplace interview panels.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Dropping the ending 'lf' in 'yourself' completely as 'yorsel'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Blow soft wind for the final 'f' at the end of 'yourself' to present full focus.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Idan ka nemi aiki a babban shago, ofis ko kamfani, tambaya ta farko dake da muhimmanci ita ce: 'Tell me about yourself' (Gaya min game da kanka). Zamu koyi yadda za mu kware wajen amsa.
lessons.englishExplanation: Master interview evaluation techniques and clean verbal resume formatting statements.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Balance stress pattern across 'about' and 'yourself'. Release 'Tell me' smoothly.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Sannu aboki! Yau manyan mutane dake neman shugabanci zasu yi farin ciki. Kalmarmu ta yau ita ce mafi amfani a teburin neman aiki: 'Tell me about yourself'.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Faruci ne mai matukar ban sha'awa da girma!
aiTutorScript.corrections: Fitarda iska kadan na harafin 'F' a karshe: 'Your-selFFFF'. Maimaita.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Yanzu kun daukaka zuwa babban matakin neman arziki!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Yarenka shi ne makamin samun girmamawa a gaban masu kudi.

lessons.listeningExercise: Listen to a formal business office chime and interviewer clearing throat for dialogue.
lessons.repeatAfterMeExercise: Repeat formal trigger request: 'Tell me about yourself' (chime).
lessons.speakingPractice: vocalize the interviewer's question to model clean pronunciation.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur (Interviewer): 'Welcome! Tell me about yourself.' Learner: 'My name is Amina, I can speak English.'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A sleek modern office chair and welcoming conference table.

quiz.question: What does an interviewer expect when they say 'Tell me about yourself'?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Mene ne ake nufi idan aka tambaye ka 'Tell me about yourself' a wurin neman aiki?
options: To give a brief personal/professional introduction
quiz.explanation: This statement is the universal icebreaker for personal presentation.

lessons.assessment: Verify that learner does not drop the 'f' sound in 'yourself'.
lessons.homework: Practice repeating 'My name is [name], I can speak English' in front of your mirror.
lessons.masteryCriteria: Clean execution of double ending consonants.

lessons.title: Explaining Daily Activities
lessons.learningObjective: Acquire rapid speech triggering habits, describing basic scene visuals immediately without translation delay.

vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Adding an 'E' to school as 'Es-kul' or shortening 'see' flat.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Do not add an 'E' at start of 'school'. Smoothly slide snake air 'S' into 'kul'.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Mafi yawan mutane sukan tsaya suna fassara kalmomi daga Hausa zuwa Turanci a zuciya kafin su yi magana. Wannan kuskure ne dake kawo jinkiri. A yau zamu kalli hoto, mu fadi abin da muka gani kai tsaye: 'I see a school'.
lessons.englishExplanation: Train instant visual-concept matching routes to promote pure immersion and cognitive fluency.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Attack 'school' cleanly with continuous S hiss without vowel additions. Keep 'see' long and bright.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Barka dai! Babban sirrin sani shi ne daina fassara a rano. Kalli screen din yanzu! Idan ka ga makaranta, fadi: 'I see a school'.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Wannan shi ne jigon hasken da muke nema!
aiTutorScript.corrections: Maimaita: 'I see a... Sss-chool'. Kar kace 'Eskey' ko 'Es-kul'.
aiTutorScript.achievements: Kun kashe tsoron fassara gaba daya a cikin tunaninku!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Yaron da ya san yadda za ya tattauna kai tsaye shi ne sarkin magana.

lessons.listeningExercise: Listen to school bells ringing and children reading in a classroom.
lessons.repeatAfterMeExercise: Look at the screen visual and repeat: 'I see a school' (chime).
lessons.speakingPractice: Explain the classroom landscape: 'I see a school'.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'Look at the picture. What do you see?' Learner: 'I see a school.'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A graphic showing a brightly lit schoolhouse under an shining orange sun.

quiz.question: How do you bypass slow inner translation when you see a house?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Yaya zaka daina jinkirin fassara a zuciya idan ka ga babban gida?
options: Say what you see immediately in English: 'I see a house'
Translate to Hausa first, then search word-for-word
Keep quiet and do not speak
quiz.explanation: Thinking directly in English bypasses mental translations to make your speech fast.

lessons.assessment: Verify low latencies in speech responses (trigger time less than 1.5s).
lessons.homework: Ka duba waje, sannan ka fadi abin da ka gani kai tsaye: 'I see water' ko 'I see bread'.
lessons.masteryCriteria: Low speaking latency with zero visual pauses.

lessons.title: Complete Free-Flow Conversation Review
lessons.learningObjective: Demonstrate high-capacity fluency across all interactive lifelike situations.

vocabulary.hausa: Zan iya magana da Turanci da kwarin gwiwa
vocabulary.commonHausaMistake: Saying 'Ah kan' or dropping nasal ending in 'confidently'.
vocabulary.correctionTip: Keep the transitions between 'speak' and 'English' fluid and clean.

lessons.hausaExplanation: Alhamdulillah! Kun kai kololuwa na hasken dandalin Nur al-Ilm! Yau za mu raba dukkan manyan sakamako. Za mu gudanar da tattaunawa ta hadaka na mintuna kadan a kan dukkan abubuwan da muka koya tun daga sifiri.
lessons.englishExplanation: Perform comprehensive oral capstone check to activate certification status.
lessons.pronunciationGuide: Produce confident, continuous conversational phrases. Breathe easy and connect thoughts.

aiTutorScript.introduction: Assalamu Alaikum wa rahmatullah! Wannan babban murna ne gare mu baki daya. Ka isa karshen hasken ilimi! Fito da muryarka cike da kwarin gwigwa: 'I can speak English confidently!'.
aiTutorScript.encouragement: Masha Allah! Ina kusa da ku muna sanya maku albarka kowace rana!
aiTutorScript.corrections: Lafazinku yanzu ya zama kusan daidai da kowane kwararre a duniya. Barka da nasara!
aiTutorScript.achievements: Kun kammala dukkan dandalin hasken Nur al-Ilm lafiya laye!
aiTutorScript.motivation: Hasken yau ya zama abokin tafiyarka na karshe. Sai an jima abokinmu!

lessons.listeningExercise: Listen to a soft celebratory sound with crowd clapping and Ustaz Nur congratulating you.
lessons.repeatAfterMeExercise: Repeat proudly: 'I can speak English confidently!' (chime).
lessons.speakingPractice: Speak the absolute capstone statement to lock in your victory.
lessons.conversationPractice: Ustaz Nur: 'Are you ready to change the world?' Learner: 'I can speak English confidently!'
lessons.visualLearningSuggestions: A sparkling certificate of completion displaying user active name with golden crown.

quiz.question: What is the true golden rule of Nur al-Ilm?
quiz.hausaQuestion: Mene ne babban jigon dandalin Nur al-Ilm da kuka bi don samun nasara?
options: Listening first, Speaking second, then Conversations, Reading & Writing last
Alphabet first, Grammar rules, Memorizing spelling sheets
Only reading silent letters while keeping mouth shut always
Doing mock visual tasks without repeating audio
quiz.explanation: Nur al-Ilm focuses on natural listening and speaking first before ever introducing academic spelling.

lessons.assessment: Verify that speech matches normal speed ratios under fluent standards.
lessons.homework: Ka danna wajen Lambar Shaidar Karatu sannan ka sauke certificate dinka na girmamawa!
